notes: Two routes (Muhammad b. Rafi' and Abd b. Humayd, who both transmit from Abd al-Razzaq) meet at عبد الرزاق. «قال عبد أخبرنا وقال ابن رافع» and «- واللفظ له -» are a speaker tag and an editor's gloss, left out. «قال لي الزهري» makes Zuhri the source for Ma'mar. After the first saying there is a second report with its own chain («قال الزهري وحدثني حميد، عن أبي هريرة، عن رسول الله»), which is not a route; it begins after the first matn.
